answer: A convincing sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: influence equals account age times verified honest epochs, so fresh copies start near zero power however many exist. Attacking means a long voyage of patient participation, waiting tide after tide of settlement cycles while staking escrow bonds peers attest to; one cheat burns the bond and resets the multiplier. Mass-producing sparrow-weight sockpuppets yields negligible voice per copy, and years-long maturation plus bonded capital makes scale-up too costly, so growth is earned not minted.
